claims.statement: All bootstrap scripts are deterministic Node .mjs that never install software and fail fast with exit 2 plus exact remediation commands.
Bootstrap attachments are idempotent via trailing-whitespace and newline-at-EOF normalized byte-compare; re-running when the marked section already matches the template is a no-op without rewrite.

When root AGENTS.md already exists and does not match the vendored baseline, init_agents_md.mjs does not write, exits 2 naming the conflict and printing the verbatim question Replace AGENTS.md with the FerroxLabs baseline, or combine both using the LLM? plus --replace and --combine flags, without using stdin.
With --replace, init_agents_md.mjs overwrites root AGENTS.md with the vendored baseline wrapped in AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers including the provenance header.

With --combine, init_agents_md.mjs never modifies the original; it stages the existing AGENTS.md, the vendored baseline, and a generated COMBINE.md merge brief side-by-side under .agents/sessions/agents-md-combine/<timestamp>/ and prints agent instructions for LLM merge.

The FerroxLabs baseline is vendored offline at .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/references/agents-md-baseline-template.md wrapped in AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers with a provenance header containing upstream URL, capture date, MIT license notice and refresh pointer; seeding never touches the network and copies the block verbatim.

refresh_agents_baseline.mjs is opt-in only: it fetches upstream to a temp file, validates non-empty and expected section anchors, swaps only content between AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers in the vendored template and updates the provenance header date, leaving other zones byte-identical; offline or validation failure exits non-zero and leaves the previously vendored baseline intact.

A fully bootstrapped AGENTS.md contains exactly one block per family ordered baseline → OpenWiki → AKSK Routing → AKSK Lifecycle with distinct markers AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE, OPENWIKI:START/END, AKSK:ROUTING, AKSK:LIFECYCLE; refreshing one zone leaves other zones byte-identical and docs-lint checks each zone as an independent integrity unit.
Templates carry their own BEGIN/END marker pairs and scripts read markers from the template at runtime via markersOf rather than hard-coding them; this makes zone renames template-only changes.

Supported bootstrap order is deterministic: init_agents_md.mjs seeds baseline first, then OpenWiki block attaches below it, then attach_section.mjs appends ROUTING and LIFECYCLE below OpenWiki; init is a separate script from attach_section.mjs to preserve attach_section's append-only invariant that existing content is never replaced.

attach_section.mjs is append-only outside markers, idempotent and self-updating via in-place refresh when the template changed, creates a missing target file containing only the attached section, and exits 2 on unknown template name or when the target is a directory.

attach_wiki_contract.mjs never creates openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md; if missing it exits 2 naming the verbatim prerequisite openwiki --init with no writes, otherwise appends the wiki-contract section below existing content stub-aware, and is idempotent by refreshing only content between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers.

check_peer_tools.mjs verifies peer binaries via PATH directory scan with PATHEXT on Windows, exports INSTALL_COMMANDS mapping openspec to npm i -g @fission-ai/openspec@latest and openwiki to npm i -g openwiki@latest, rejects unknown tool names with exit 2 before lookup, and on missing tools prints one error per tool plus install commands then exits 2.

sync_wiki_indexes.mjs refreshes OpenWiki directory indexes deterministically with no LLM and no CLI run by locating the global package via npm root -g and dynamically importing OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly true and virtualMode true plus synchronizeWikiIndexes; it exits 2 with remediation when openwiki/ is missing or the package is not installed globally.

Combine staging uses .agents/sessions/agents-md-combine/<timestamp>/ which is gitignored where only sessions/README.md is tracked, and the generated COMBINE.md brief constrains LLM merge to preserve project-specific learnings and sections 10-11, prefer baseline structure for sections 0-9, and keep AKSK and OPENWIKI marker blocks verbatim.

Bootstrap preflight (Proposal-only) detects before any write the Node.js major version (>=22 required), whether openspec and openwiki resolve on PATH, whether .agents/, openspec/, openwiki/ exist in the target repo, and whether OpenWiki install receipts .openwiki-install.json exist in known skill directories, reports this state before acting, and stops before installing on Node <22.

Bootstrap global lane (Proposal-only) installs @fission-ai/openspec@latest and openwiki@latest globally once per user via npm i -g, skips any tool already at a compatible version and reports detected versions, and verifies openwiki resolves before registering openwiki mcp --host targets.

Bootstrap per-repo lane (Proposal-only) runs openspec init when missing, scaffolds a minimal .agents/ tree from kit templates, attaches the AKSK curation contract to openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md with append-only merge, and merges a thin routing block into root AGENTS.md preserving any existing OPENWIKI:START/END block; a bare repo creates all three and a fully bootstrapped re-run changes nothing.

Bootstrap never half-installs (Proposal-only): when any step cannot be executed locally it prints the exact remaining copy-paste commands and exits clean without partial state from the failed step and without continuing past a failed prerequisite, via a two-lane EXECUTE versus INSTRUCT model.

Integration spread (Proposal-only) selects per detected agent openwiki integrations install <codex|claude|opencode> for supported hosts (atomic skill plus MCP config openwiki mcp --host <target> with .openwiki-install.json receipt) versus the headless ladder openwiki --init -p / --update -p for agents without a supported host, with no intermediate add-mcp plus npx skills add lane.

Spread enforces ownership partition by receipt (Proposal-only): before integrating it inspects via openwiki integrations list / inspectInstallation and skips any agent whose skill directory contains .openwiki-install.json with matching target and intact hashes (installed/unchanged), reports modified on hash drift and requires --force with backup to overwrite, treating the official lane as owner.

Spread produces a per-agent report (Proposal-only) naming each detected agent, the lane chosen, whether the action succeeded as installed/unchanged/modified via openwiki integrations list, and any installer output including backup path on --force.

Registry bundle source (Proposal-only) is the locally installed npm package at <npm-root>/openwiki/integrations/openwiki not a tag-pinned URL; the receipt records package, version, target, SHA-256 hashes and exact mcpServerCommand, update is npm i -g openwiki@latest then re-run integrations install idempotent, with transactional staging, symlink and non-directory parent rejection, and config snapshot rollback.
